name: 20down
description: 20 Down — a three- or four-player trick-taking game with free play and USDC wagering on Solana

scripts.build: npm run build -w @20down/app && npm run build -w @20down/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @20down/shared && npm run typecheck -w @20down/server && npm run typecheck -w @20down/app
scripts.test: npm run test -w @20down/shared && npm run test -w @20down/server
